title: Vote: release Apache Iceberg Go v0.6.0 RC0
summary: zeroshade proposed release candidate RC0 of Apache Iceberg Go v0.6.0, based on commit 53fa29cc, and asked for verification and votes. Several +1 votes followed with verification details. nssalian voted +1 but suggested another RC could include Variant non-shredding support from iceberg-go PR #932. kevinjqliu first hit a verification failure that turned out to be a test failing because he was logged in to the az CLI, then voted +1 binding. Tobias voted -1 (non-binding) because a commit made iceberg-go write a deprecated manifest field (distinct_counts) that PyIceberg rejects when reading, a regression in compatibility; iceberg-go PR #1102 would fix it. zeroshade agreed that PyIceberg compatibility must not break and said he would merge the fix and cut a new RC, so this candidate was not released.

positions.stance: The RC is good to go, though cutting another RC with Variant non-shredding support would be preferable if PR #932 merges soon.
Do not release: a commit made iceberg-go write a deprecated field that PyIceberg rejects, breaking compatibility that existed before.
PyIceberg compatibility must not be broken, so the fix will be merged and a new RC cut.

outcome.note: The release manager said he would merge the PyIceberg compatibility fix and cut a new RC. Before that the thread had 1 binding +1, 4 non-binding +1 and 1 non-binding -1.

why_it_matters: A release candidate was dropped because manifests written by iceberg-go could no longer be read by PyIceberg, showing cross-implementation compatibility is treated as release-blocking.
